candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification - Grid data
verified_facts: ASCII Terrain50 is a raster grid.
Each height value is calculated from the centre of each 50m by 50m pixel.
Each tile has 200 pixels per row and ASCII height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m.
semantic_limits: Pixel-centre value semantics do not mean a polygon-intersecting all_touched pixel centre is inside the polygon.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Known Data Issues
verified_facts: The official page currently reports no live known data issues for OS Terrain 50.
semantic_limits: Absence of listed live issues is not proof that every cell is error-free and does not alter the 4m RMSE accuracy contract.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Product supply
verified_facts: ASCII/GML supply is available as an online download without registration.
National tiled supply uses 10km-by-10km tiles arranged under 100km grid-square folders.
Terrain50 full-tile resupply is annual each July.
semantic_limits: Supply availability does not establish that current TQ archive bytes were observed in this support runtime.

candidates.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
verified_facts: HMLR data is captured against British National Grid.
Reprojection from British National Grid to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres.
semantic_limits: WGS84 remains display-only for this exact parcel measurement chain.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
verified_facts: Vertical accuracy of the LIDAR dataset is +/-15cm RMSE.
A LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS service is listed.
semantic_limits: Metadata does not replace current exact-polygon WCS sampling.
